summary.title: Text Rendering Operations Overview
summary.long_summary: The provided content enumerates various text rendering techniques commonly used in graphics and web contexts. It includes basic operations such as filling text, stroking text, and combining both fill and stroke in sequence. Additionally, it covers advanced usage where text is added to a path for clipping purposes, either by filling, stroking, or both before clipping. The list also references HTML-specific methods for filling, stroking, and combined fill‑stroke operations. Each line represents a distinct approach to rendering text, highlighting how different combinations of fill, stroke, and clipping can be applied to achieve varied visual effects.
